head_commit.message:
feat(audio,mobile): lyrics view, room-correction FIR, backup/restore, QR pairing

Second round of competitor-parity features: lyrics/now-playing, room
correction, config backup/restore, and Android QR pairing.

- Lyrics: LyrionServer.jsx now-playing panel toggles VU meters <-> lyrics
  (lyrionApi.getLyrics via the MusicArtistInfo LMS plugin), persisted choice.
- Room correction: sources_server.py adds /api/dsp/fir (upload/status/delete a
  WAV or TEXT convolution filter, fixed filename, no path-traversal surface).
  api_server.py's _camilla_config_dict wires it into the DSP pipeline as a Conv
  filter ahead of the parametric EQ, gated by a room_correction toggle in
  Settings (disabled until a filter is uploaded).
- Backup/restore: sources_server.py adds /api/backup (tar.gz export of an
  explicit allow-list: DAC/DSP/pointer/OTA-channel/sources/FIR — excludes
  OTA version bookkeeping) and /api/restore (extracts only allow-listed regular
  files, no traversal, re-applies sources/squeezelite/CamillaDSP as needed).
  Settings gets a QR/URL card pointing at the :8080 page.
- Android companion: QR-pairing in ServerAddressView — scans the same QR code
  Settings -> Phone control already shows, parses host:port from it via
  zxing-android-embedded, and fills in the server address field. Bumped
  versionCode/versionName (1.0.5 -> 1.0.6) for the companion-v1.0.6 release tag.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
feat(ui): fullscreen progress overlay during OTA updates

Blocks the UI with a fullscreen modal while any update runs (UI, system, OS,
Lyrion, or the combined "apply all") showing a live progress bar and the
current step's message, driven by the existing {state, progress, message}
poll. Terminal errors stay on screen with a dismiss button; a "don't power
off" hint shows while applying. New i18n keys under settings.updates.overlay.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(website): warn that ISO install auto-wipes the first disk

The appliance ISO installs fully unattended: no target-disk prompt and
no confirmation before formatting. It auto-selects the first detected
disk, wipes it entirely (new GPT, all data erased) and reboots. Add a
prominent bilingual warning to the install section so users don't lose
data on a machine they didn't mean to erase.
